statement: Shim-on MP-only native Dolphin 2503 control reads the exact caller MP calibration in two successful chunks and shows changing mapping-view gyro, accelerometer and two basic IR points over a 150-second bound. P3 still observes non-Dolphin initialization after mapping; no continuous-delivery, rate-accuracy, physical, game or complete-controller claim. This is an MP-only positive control, not MP+Nunchuk acceptance.

applicability.revision: Original virtual model; physical revisions unmeasured
applicability.scope: evidence_role: consumer. provenance_class: compat. Bounded virtual-host observation on code PR #256, not physical/radio/game, calibration accuracy or challenge evidence. Kernel stays bound; Cemu gyro excluded.
